description: This file declares the SessionServerAppManager class, which manages session server applications within the Rialto server manager. It includes method declarations for initializing, configuring, and controlling session servers, as well as handling their states and communication.

classes.name: SessionServerAppManager
classes.description: A class responsible for managing session server applications, including their lifecycle, state management, and communication within the Rialto server manager.

methods.name: SessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the session server app manager with dependencies such as IPC controller, state observer, factories, and event thread factory.

methods.name: ~SessionServerAppManager
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up resources.

methods.name: preloadSessionServers
methods.description: Preloads a specified number of session servers.

methods.name: initiateApplication
methods.description: Starts a new session server application with the given name, state, and configuration.

methods.name: setSessionServerState
methods.description: Updates the state of a session server identified by application name.

methods.name: onSessionServerStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in session server state, triggered by server events.

methods.name: sendPingEvents
methods.description: Sends ping events to session servers for health checks or keep-alive.

methods.name: onAck
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment responses from session servers.

methods.name: getAppConnectionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves connection information for a specified application.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets logging levels for session servers.

methods.name: connectSessionServer
methods.description: Establishes connection with a session server.

methods.name: configureSessionServer
methods.description: Configures a session server with necessary parameters.

methods.name: configurePreloadedSessionServer
methods.description: Configures a preloaded session server with application-specific settings.

methods.name: changeSessionServerState
methods.description: Changes the state of a session server based on application name.

methods.name: handleSessionServerStateChange
methods.description: Internal handler for processing session server state changes.

methods.name: handleAck
methods.description: Internal handler for processing acknowledgment responses.

methods.name: shutdownAllSessionServers
methods.description: Shuts down all managed session servers.

methods.name: launchSessionServer
methods.description: Launches a new session server with specified parameters.

methods.name: preloadSessionServer
methods.description: Preloads a session server for future use.

methods.name: getPreloadedServer
methods.description: Returns the preloaded session server.

methods.name: getServerByAppName
methods.description: Retrieves a session server by application name.

methods.name: getServerById
methods.description: Retrieves a session server by server ID.
